crossRefs.note: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts.
Your two breasts are like two fawns, that are twins of a roe.
This, your stature, is like a palm tree, your breasts like its fruit.
Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you…
I am a wall, and my breasts like towers, then I was in his eyes like one who found peace.
A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
“Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all you who mourn over…
as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow,
My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.
I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies.

translations.web: Your two breasts are like two fawns that are twins of a roe, which feed among the lilies.
translations.bsb: Your breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle grazing among the lilies.
translations.kjv: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.
translations.asv: Thy two breasts are like two fawns That are twins of a roe, Which feed among the lilies.
